images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A cozy detective game played on a miniature dollhouse, strong tilt-shift photography look with blurred top and bottom bands. Front cross-section of a two-story wooden dollhouse on a walnut table, roof with red shingles and a round attic window. Four rooms visible as open boxes with perspective depth: a pink-striped child's bedroom with a tiny bed and a desk missing its chair, a sage floral grandmother's room with a tall bookshelf and tiny glass shards glinting on the floor, a mustard damask living room with a green sofa and peg dolls, and a kitchen whose front wall is still attached, outlined with a dashed glowing line. Giant steel tweezers enter from the top-right, lifting a tiny yellow wooden chair toward a dotted ghost outline under the shelf. A brass magnifying glass enlarges chair-leg scuff marks. Each room lit by a warm pendant bulb. Right: a spiral detective notebook with a testimony card '할머니 인형' and a red tag '증언 변화', checklist, progress '3 / 5 일치'. Title '인형의 집 탐정'. Warm miniature photography meets illustration, walnut, cream, dusty rose, sage, brass.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same miniature detective game at night, under a warm desk lamp on a dark walnut table. Left half: a child's spiral diary page, lined paper, wobbly blue pencil handwriting in Korean, a crayon drawing of a grey cat and a flying blue glass bird with red text '쨍그랑!', and a rubbed-out eraser smudge. A large brass magnifying glass over the smudge reveals faint erased words '내 의자를 가져갔다…' in pale graphite. Right half: a close-up window into the dollhouse grandmother's room at night, moon in the window, peg dolls of a grandmother and a little girl facing a tiny yellow chair placed beneath the shelf where the glass bird used to stand, shards glinting; small speech bubbles above the dolls. Bottom right: a dark verdict panel reading '배치는 5 / 5 일치' with two contradictions marked by red crosses and three buttons, the highlighted one '서연이에게 말 걸기'. Tilt-shift miniature feel, warm amber lamp, deep brown shadows, soft film grain, gentle bittersweet mood.
